tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get a single published Community Days event by its URL slug.

tools.name: get_event_sessions
tools.description: Get all indexed sessions for an event by its URL slug, each with its speaker's name and speakerId (for get_speaker).

tools.name: get_speaker
tools.description: Get a speaker's full profile: bio, links, counts, the events, cities and countries they have spoken in, and every session they have given, newest first. One answer per person, across Sessionize and run.events.

tools.name: get_speaker_sessions
tools.description: Get every session a speaker has given, newest first, across Sessionize and run.events.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List published Community Days events with the events page's filters, no keyword needed: e.g. upcoming events with an open call for speakers, open registration or sponsorship, by cost, type or country. Upcoming soonest first; past most recent first.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search published Community Days events by keyword. Returns up to 20 matching events: upcoming events first (soonest first), then past events (most recent first).

tools.name: search_speakers
tools.description: Search Community Days speakers by name. Returns up to 20 people, one entry each (Sessionize and run.events identities the speaker board has merged appear once), most sessions first, with their session, hour, event and country counts.
